article.title_en: City Harvest Mobile Market: food pantry in Sunset Park, Brooklyn
article.summary_es: City Harvest Mobile Market es una despensa de alimentos en Sunset Park, Brooklyn, que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre viernes y sábado de 10am a 12pm.
article.summary_en: City Harvest Mobile Market is a food pantry in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Friday and Saturday from 10am to 12pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 150 52nd St, Brooklyn, NY 11232.
Abre viernes y sábado de 10am a 12pm.
La despensa solo abre el segundo viernes y el cuarto sábado de cada mes.
Qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos no aparecen en la información disponible.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 150 52nd St, Brooklyn, NY 11232.
It is open Friday and Saturday from 10am to 12pm.
The pantry is only open the 2nd Friday and 4th Saturday of each month.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed in the available information.
visit_tips_es: Verifique la fecha antes de ir: la despensa solo abre el segundo viernes y el cuarto sábado.
El horario es de 10am a 12pm los viernes y sábados.
Si tiene preguntas, llame al (646) 412-0729 antes de visitar.
visit_tips_en: Check the date before you go: the pantry is only open the 2nd Friday and 4th Saturday.
Hours are 10am to 12pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
If you have questions, call (646) 412-0729 before visiting.
